prerequisites: Knowledge of technical drawing and basic material strength

learning_outcomes.text: learn about the construction and purpose of basic machine elements
learn the principles of calculating and designing machine assemblies
learn the ability to read and prepare design documentation

syllabus_topics: Computer programmes supporting Design Structural calculations
Criteria strength calculations for machine elements
Stiffness, stability and durability of structures
Connections: press-fit, bolted, shaped, welded, soldered, glued, riveted, tubular and valves
Solving selected problems of calculating components of machinery not covered in the project
teaching_methods: Lecture with elements of multimedia presentations

assessment_methods.method: Passing the examination (comprehensive response to at least three questions out of five)
